picks.game: San Jose Sharks vs Toronto Maple Leafs
picks.rationale: The Toronto Maple Leafs are significantly impacted by injuries, with Max Domi, Christopher Tanev, and John Tavares all out, and William Nylander questionable due to illness, which severely limits their offensive firepower. While both teams have shown defensive inconsistencies, the recent head-to-head trend between the Sharks and Maple Leafs has seen the total go under 6.5 in the last two meetings and 60% of the last five. San Jose's average goals allowed per game is 3.5, but Toronto's weakened offense is unlikely to exploit this fully. Given the key absences for Toronto and the recent H2H trends, the Under 6.5 at plus money offers strong value.

The Colorado Avalanche boast a potent offense, ranking 3rd in the NHL with 36 goals in 8 games, averaging 4.5 goals per game. The Philadelphia Flyers are dealing with potential injuries to key forwards Tyson Foerster and Sean Couturier, both listed as game-time decisions, which could impact their defensive structure and overall team play. Colorado has recently demonstrated its scoring prowess with a 5-2 win over Pittsburgh and a 7-3 victory against Calgary. The Flyers' defense has struggled in recent head-to-head matchups with the Avalanche in the 2020s, allowing an average of 3.8 goals per game. With Colorado's high-octane offense and Philadelphia's defensive uncertainties, the Over 6.5 at plus money is a high-confidence play.

The Pittsburgh Penguins are on a tough road trip, coming off back-to-back losses where they conceded 6 goals to Vegas and 5 to Colorado, highlighting defensive vulnerabilities and potential fatigue. The Utah Mammoth possess a strong offense and an exceptional power play, converting over one-third of their opportunities, which can exploit Pittsburgh's respectable but not airtight penalty kill. Head-to-head matchups between these teams have historically been high-scoring, averaging 7 goals per game. Utah has won 3 of its last 5 games, scoring 4 or more goals in those victories, while Pittsburgh has allowed 5 or more goals in 3 of its last 5 outings. These factors combine to create a strong expectation for a high-scoring affair.

picks.game: Anaheim Ducks vs New York Rangers
picks.rationale: The New York Rangers, with a 6-3-1 record, exhibit a solid defensive structure and will be playing at home. The Anaheim Ducks are severely hampered by injuries to key offensive players Troy Terry, Mikael Granlund (questionable), and Ryan Poehling, which will significantly diminish their scoring capabilities. Historically, the Rangers have a favorable record against the Ducks, winning 10 of 16 all-time meetings. The moneyline has seen a modest shift towards the Rangers, indicating market confidence in the home favorite. With Anaheim's depleted forward group and New York's defensive strength at home, the Rangers are well-positioned for a win.

picks.game: San Jose Sharks vs Toronto Maple Leafs
picks.rationale: Auston Matthews is an elite goal scorer and will be heavily relied upon for offense, especially with key Maple Leafs forwards John Tavares and Max Domi out, and William Nylander questionable. The San Jose Sharks present a favorable matchup for Matthews, as they have struggled defensively, allowing an average of 3.5 goals per game. Matthews is projected to score over 0.5 goals in this game. His high shot volume and scoring ability, combined with San Jose's defensive weaknesses, make him a strong candidate to find the back of the net. The plus money odds offer excellent value for this prop.

picks.game: Cleveland Guardians vs Tampa Bay Rays
picks.rationale: The Tampa Bay Rays are playing at home, where they boast a strong 58-27 record in 2026, including playoff games. They enter this pivotal ALCS Game 6 with significant momentum, leading the series 3-2 after winning their last two matchups against the Guardians. Rays' starting pitcher Freddy Peralta is in exceptional form, having posted a 0.96 ERA in September and delivering six scoreless innings against Cleveland in Game 2 of this series. In contrast, the Guardians are facing an elimination game with a planned bullpen day, as their ace Gavin Williams is being held for a potential Game 7, creating a considerable pitching disadvantage.

picks.game: Cleveland Guardians vs Tampa Bay Rays
picks.rationale: Freddy Peralta's dominant pitching is a key factor for the Under, as he previously held this Guardians lineup scoreless over six innings in Game 2 of the ALCS. The Cleveland Guardians' offense has been struggling, batting only .200 in their last five head-to-head games against the Rays and managing just four runs combined in their last two contests. While Cleveland is utilizing a bullpen game, the low total of 6.5 suggests an expectation of limited scoring, especially given the high stakes of an elimination game. Furthermore, three of the last five ALCS games between these two teams have resulted in the total going Under 6.5 runs.

picks.game: Cleveland Guardians vs Tampa Bay Rays
picks.rationale: The Tampa Bay Rays are strong contenders at home, boasting a 58-27 record at Tropicana Field this season, including playoff games. Their starting pitcher, Freddy Peralta, has been exceptional, allowing only one run over 6 2/3 total innings against the Guardians in this ALCS, including a six-inning scoreless outing in Game 2. Cleveland is forced into a bullpen game due to their ace being rested for a potential Game 7, presenting a significant disadvantage against a hot Rays lineup and pitching staff. The Rays have demonstrated their ability to cover this spread, winning their last two games against the Guardians by margins of four runs (7-3) and two runs (3-1).

The San Francisco 49ers are dealing with significant injuries to their receiving corps, with Deebo Samuel ruled OUT and Mike Evans listed as DNP with multiple injuries, alongside other injured wideouts. This depletion could limit their offensive explosiveness and lead to a lower-scoring affair. Historical betting trends also support the Under, as the 51.5 line has not been covered in 4 of the last 5 Commanders road games and 14 of the last 20 49ers home games. Furthermore, the total has climbed 1.5 points from its opening of 50.0 to 51.5, potentially creating value on the Under due to an overcorrection.

With key wide receivers Deebo Samuel OUT and Mike Evans questionable/injured, George Kittle is poised for an increased target share in the 49ers' offense. Kittle is healthy and ranks highly among tight ends in targets, air yards, and yards after catch (YAC). The Washington Commanders' defense has struggled against tight ends this season, allowing the fifth-most receiving yards per game to the position, creating a favorable matchup for Kittle to exceed this total.

Brock Purdy has demonstrated a consistent ability to exceed his rushing totals this season, going Over in four of his five games and rushing for 29+ yards in those instances. The Commanders' defense has shown vulnerability to rushing quarterbacks, allowing the seventh-highest mark in the league at 19.4 rushing yards per game to opposing QBs. With the 49ers' receiving corps depleted by injuries, Purdy may be more inclined to scramble or execute designed runs, further boosting his rushing yardage.

The San Francisco 49ers are missing key defensive player Nick Bosa and several starting wide receivers, including Deebo Samuel, which could impact their ability to cover a significant spread. The Washington Commanders, with a healthy Jayden Daniels at quarterback, have played competitively against strong opponents, including a two-point loss to the Eagles and an overtime tie with the Giants. Additionally, Washington's defense ranks surprisingly well in rush EPA (sixth in the league), which could help contain the 49ers' potent ground game.

Despite Jayden Daniels' impressive 103 rushing yards last week, he faces an elite San Francisco 49ers defense that excels at containing opposing quarterbacks on the ground. The 49ers' defense allows an average of only 6.6 rushing yards per game to quarterbacks, a testament to their disciplined approach. They have successfully shut down other mobile quarterbacks, such as Malik Willis, limiting him to just 6 rushing yards. This tough matchup suggests Daniels will find it difficult to replicate his recent rushing success.
